definitions.full: H6656. tseda צְדָא noun [masculine] usually (malicious) purpose (Hebraism from Biblical Hebrew צְדִיָּה , √ I. צדה ); — with ה interrogative הַצְדָּא Dan 3:14 ; < read הַאַוְדָּא Bev Dr Kmp.
